title: Successor-field transition machine
statement: For a natural number $m$, two work-tape indices $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and a Boolean choice $c$, define an $m$-work-tape machine with Boolean tape alphabet and the three successor-processing phases. It starts in the tag phase. In that phase it moves the source head one cell right and enters the unary phase if the scanned source symbol is $1$, and otherwise completes with the live flag false. In the unary phase it moves the source head right, and, when $c$ is true, writes the scanned source symbol on the destination tape; it remains in the unary phase if that symbol is $1$, and otherwise completes with the live flag true. In a completed phase it stays put on all tapes and preserves that phase and its flag.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ of work tapes
